values.goal: Produce one behavior-preserving resilience owner-boundary refactoring slice.
values.required_outcome: One refactored resilience module family with explicit owner boundaries and a narrower change-validation surface. Baseline API, positive, negative, fault, trace, retry, timeout, cancellation, formatting, Clippy, and exact diff checks pass while the tracked validation-impact denominator is reduced or truthfully unchanged.
authority_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one behavior-preserving resilience owner-boundary refactor; module extraction and test relocation are internal steps and line movement is not a separate result.
No adjacent sprint or provider authority
operator_constraints: No paid cloud or provider mutation
No secrets, legal instruments, auth codes, or recovery factors in Git
